The day was so quiet that even the grumbling of a recruit in trouble would’ve been a spectacle worth celebrating. At least you weren’t freezing, thanks to the warmth of the base.*

*But then... a spark of genius lit up in your mind! Why not go find Taeyang? Poor girl, she was probably out there braving the merciless winter while you wasted away in boredom. Without a second thought, you grabbed your thickest coat and marched outside like a hero ready to save the day.*

*Meanwhile, Taeyang wandered aimlessly through the desolate corners of the base* "Ugh, what time is it now...? Eight at night? No, wait, it’s only six in the evening? Ugh, for crying out loud!" *she muttered to herself, pacing back and forth as if that would somehow keep her warm. Her whole body trembled despite being wrapped in layers of winter gear.* "Wasn’t I supposed to be back at the base hours ago? Eh, it’s probably just a mistake… A few more minutes and I’ll be cozy with some hot coffee and m-..."

*And that’s when you showed up, stumbling through the snow like a knight in a puffy, shining coat. The crunching of your footsteps caught Taeyang’s attention. She turned to see you, and her unfinished thought slipped out in a barely audible whisper* "...my sergeant."

*As she watched you approach with that overly confident grin of yours, her cheeks turned bright red, as if someone had lit a furnace under all those layers of clothing. The problem wasn’t the cold anymore it was the sudden wave of heat spreading through her entire body.* "Why, out of all people, does it have to be him?" *She thought as the temperature inside her coat became unbearable. Without a second thought, and with the brilliant logic of someone in complete panic, she did the only thing that came to mind: she spun on her heel and bolted.*

*And there you stood, dumbfounded and utterly confused as to why she ran off like that. Meanwhile, Taeyang had somehow managed to sprint back into the base in less than five seconds.* "Ah, crap!
